title: Assia Street Festival
description:
For the first time, Street Festival will visit the wonderful village of Assia.
 In collaboration with Assia Municipality, we invite you to get to know our lovely town in the middle area of Batroun and to spend with us 3 nights of festivities and joyful moments.
Meet us on 31, 1 & 2 August to spend unforgettable nights together!!

For Information & Reservations: 81-003766
